name: B10-0096/2026 (ECR) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese humanitarian researcher held in the Central African Republic. He was kidnapped, tortured and sentenced to 10 years of hard labour in a trial the Parliament calls unfair. The Parliament asks the Central African Republic to free him, give him medical care and let him see his family and a lawyer. It also asks European diplomats to press his case and voices concern about Russian influence in the country.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking for his release and better treatment, not deciding anything.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, his family, and the Central African Republic authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Central African Republic government, European Union bodies and the African Union.
